_comment: Issue #23 (Social Pillar II, the per-waking dialogue seam): stage 3 ALREADY reached for BOTH Erin (erin_friend_of_the_inn) and Relc (relc_brother_in_arms), entity_first_use empty (neither once_per_waking gate used yet this waking) -- the FIXTURE-FIRST policy precedent (krshia_stage3_pre) applied to the two NPCs this issue actually ships. Positioned at the inn, adjacent to Erin (7,2) facing up, so the FIRST interact step opens her REAL hub directly (social_talked already carries {erin:true, relc:true}, mirroring krshia_stage3_pre's same trick -- a fresh waking would otherwise consume a talk_pool line first). Erin's hub option count is pinned to exactly 4 visible entries: has_package/errand_decided hide the package-pickup row (hide_when); cleaned_the_inn+reported_cleaning TOGETHER hide BOTH cleaning-adjacent rows -- 'Let me deal with that table.' is a requires:{skill:...} option (VISIBLE-LOCKED, not progress-gated, so it shows regardless of basic_cleaning possession unless its OWN hide_when:cleaned_the_inn is met) and 'The table situation is handled.' only becomes visible once cleaned_the_inn is met, so it needs its own hide_when:reported_cleaning to clear in turn; gave_reward/kept_reward stay unmet (hides the epilogue rows). See stage3_perks_loop.json's own comments for the resulting visible-index math. Relc carries met_relc/sparred_with_relc/given_spear_by_relc (post-onboarding honest state, the spear gift already claimed so it doesn't add a 5th meet-hub row) plus cleared_the_warren and chatted_with_relc:3 for his own stage 3 -- none of Relc's meet-hub options use the requires:{skill/class} shape, so no equivalent extra row there. gold:0 so the wager's +1 is exact and unambiguous.
